headline: The first try works
fortune: Before Thursday's chai gets cold, one thing you worried about goes right on the first try. Enjoy the suspicious peace.

headline: The stubborn task gives up
fortune: A small task that has annoyed you suddenly becomes easy before lunch. Mithu will pretend he planned it.

headline: The day behaves nicely
fortune: Your next busy day runs strangely smoothly: you arrive on time, find what you need, and get the good seat.

headline: Lunch brings the answer
fortune: While telling someone what is bothering you, the answer pops out of your own mouth. Take credit before Mithu does.

headline: The right words arrive
fortune: A kind message reaches you at exactly the right moment and makes one confusing choice feel simple.

headline: A lovely name appears
fortune: Tomorrow, you find the perfect name for a plan, pet, dish, or tiny dream. It will sound obvious afterward.

headline: A short walk fixes the mood
fortune: Five minutes away from your chair brings back the idea and energy you were chasing. Even the chai looks proud.

headline: A boring plan disappears
fortune: One dull plan gets cancelled early, leaving you a pocket of free time. Guard that tiny holiday.

headline: A tidy corner pays off
fortune: You clear one messy corner and find the thing you thought was lost. The corner requests applause.

headline: A small effort gets big praise
fortune: Something simple you do this week earns a warmer thank-you than expected. Accept the praise without arguing.

headline: Less becomes much better
fortune: By Friday, you remove one unnecessary thing from your day and immediately breathe easier. Very elegant. Tiny bow.

headline: One detail makes a day
fortune: A thoughtful detail you almost skip makes someone smile. You notice, and your day improves too.

headline: The mistake is easy to fix
fortune: One scary-looking mistake is completely fixed in ten minutes. Your heartbeat may need slightly longer.

headline: You pause at the perfect second
fortune: You stop one hasty message before sending it. Future-you sends a thank-you laddoo.

headline: Plan B steals the show
fortune: Next week, your backup plan works so well that the first plan starts calling it boss.
